---
title: "Examples"
---

This section contains examples of Flower's built-in styles rendered as a
website. The examples demonstrate how content is structured---not what a
full website would look like in detail. Colors, fonts, and other visual
aspects can be customised through the website generator's theming system
(see the
[Quarto theming documentation](https://quarto.org/docs/output-formats/html-themes.html)
for details). The design decisions behind these styles are described in
the [output interface page](/docs/design/interface/outputs.qmd).

- [Style: Quarto one page](quarto-one-page/index.qmd)
